title.en: Internet Technology: The Whole Journey of a Web Visit
title.zh: 互联网技术：一次网页访问走过的全程

summary.en: Layering and reference models, the physical layer, the data link layer and Ethernet, IP and routing, UDP/TCP and congestion control, DNS/HTTP/email/streaming, network security
summary.zh: 分层与参考模型、物理层、数据链路层与以太网、IP 与路由、UDP/TCP 与拥塞控制、DNS/HTTP/邮件/流媒体、网络安全

audience.en: University students who have studied basic computer principles and can use a browser, matching COMP90007 Internet Technologies. No prior networking is needed; a little binary and log2 helps.
audience.zh: 学过基本计算机原理、会用浏览器的大学生，对应 COMP90007 互联网技术；不需要先学过网络，会一点二进制和 log2 更好。

outcomes.en: Follow one web visit and say what each layer does, what header it adds, and why the work is divided this way
outcomes.zh: 能顺着一次网页访问，说出每一层做了什么、加了什么头、为什么这样分工

outcomes.en: Do the calculations that come up in exams: delay, channel capacity, CRC and Hamming codes, subnets and longest prefix matching, Dijkstra, the congestion window
outcomes.zh: 能做考试里的计算：延迟、信道容量、CRC 与汉明码、子网与最长前缀匹配、Dijkstra、拥塞窗口

outcomes.en: Explain why each protocol is designed the way it is, and give reasons for the trade-offs between UDP and TCP, error detection and correction, symmetric and public-key cryptography
outcomes.zh: 能解释每个协议为什么这样设计，并在 UDP 与 TCP、检错与纠错、对称与公钥等取舍里说出理由
